name: Define camera-area taxonomy
title: Define camera-area taxonomy
description:
Create the organizational/site hierarchy used to group cameras (for example, city → district → site). Save parent groups before child areas; mark a node as a group only when it has children. Choose concise, unique labels that operators will recognize and avoid encoding temporary status in the area name.

A Camera Area is the operational inventory taxonomy; it is distinct from Geo Admin Area (jurisdiction) and Geo Boundary (geometry). A camera can have an operational area and separate geographic references. Verify parent/child navigation before assigning cameras.
